text:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync — thinking we should pivot the Dedic capacity roadmap for Q3. Proposal: drop the multi-region reserved pools MVP, focus current sprint on autoscale policy improvements (preempt smoothing + per-tenant admission rules) and a smaller quota UI. Customer asks (Acme + Beta cohort) for strong burst guarantees still exist, but we can satisfy with policy + clearer SLOs rather than full multi-region reserve. Thoughts?
Tom (Eng): +1 to narrowing scope. Multi-region will blow up infra work and delay SLA features.
Jun (Runtime): We can ship preempt smoothing and admission rules in ~3 weeks if we freeze model compatibility work. Need to quantify perf regression risk for large-context models.
Priya (SRE): Concern: if we de-prioritize reserve pools, oncall will see more cross-tenant noisy neighbor incidents during promos. We need a mitigation checklist — auto-evict thresholds + a dashboard alert. 
Carlos (Sales): From customer side: Acme will accept a documented burst SLA tied to quota windows if we provide credits for failures. They prefer predictable latency over multi-region failover. That buys us room.
Sam (DevEx): We should make the quota UI tiny but discoverable. A task: add “burst leash” toggle and a tooltip explaining carryover behavior. Can do in one sprint.
Aisha (PM): Ok so decision points: (1) drop multi-region MVP from Q3 (2) prioritize autoscale policy + admission rules (3) ship minimal quota UI + docs (4) contract language for burst SLAs. Agree?
Tom (Eng): Agree. Also proposal: split autoscale work into two tickets: policy core + rollout tooling (canary + metric gates). Rollout tooling is lower risk and separate.
Jun (Runtime): FYI, policy core requires a KV-cache change to track per-session burst tokens — I estimate 5 dev-days. Rollout tooling needs infra hooks ~8 dev-days.
Priya (SRE): I'll draft mitigation runbook and alert templates. Need signal requirements from Jun.
Carlos (Sales): I'll scope contract changes with legal and estimate customer acceptance. Acme wants an opt-in beta for burst credits.
deploy-bot: Release window open: autoscale-policy branch queued for staging deploy 2pm PST.
Aisha (PM): Next steps: Jun + Tom to confirm tickets & estimates by EOD Thursday. Priya to draft runbook by Friday. Carlos to confirm Acme opt-in by next Tue. Sam to stub UI copy and mockups. I'll update roadmap doc and ping execs. :thumbsup:
Tom (Eng): Added action items in the sprint board — link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RI-987
Aisha (PM): Thanks all — keeping this scoped will let us deliver measurable SLOs without the full multi-region lift.
